description: In a notable intensification of their trade spat, the United States and Canada have introduced new restrictions following a series of tariff impositions. The latest US measures impact Canadian dairy and alcohol goods, prompting Canada to seek diminished economic reliance on America. Currently, both nations are evaluating their positions with no immediate discussions on the horizon.
title: Old allies drift apart as US bans Canada's dairy, alcohol and motorcycles

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Alpine glaciers are shrinking rapidly, driven by escalating temperatures. The thawing of permafrost is leading to unstable cliffs, resulting in increased rockfalls. This year, the Mont Blanc massif has witnessed more frequent rock collapses. Regions previously blanketed in snow are now experiencing rainfall, which disrupts the stability of the terrain. Towns like Chamonix-Mont-Blanc face a looming threat of potential mountain collapses.
title: Not just Nepal: How climate change puts European Alps under threat

author: TNN
description: A disturbing case emerged where a woman was allegedly murdered by her father and brother in a supposed act of family honour. The crime was triggered by a viral video showcasing her with a male acquaintance. To conceal their heinous act, the accused staged it as a road accident, brutally attacking her with a hammer in a remote area. The police have now initiated a murder case against the perpetrators.
title: 'Smashed head': Father, brother kill woman over viral video with male friend

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple is expected to launch its foldable iPhone, possibly named iPhone Ultra, soon.  Tim Cook's vision, inspired by Asian market trends, drove this new design.  Engineers have researched flexible screens and hinges for years, with early prototypes focusing on tablets.  The V68 project, internally codenamed, faced significant engineering complexity and rising costs.  Despite potential consumer pushback, Apple sees market potential in premium foldable devices.
title: How Tim Cook pushed Apple into a new era set for John Ternus’ CEO debut

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a tragic incident in Delhi, a PG building collapsed, resulting in the death of seven students, including Arpit Jai. His family, having identified him at AIIMS, chose to donate his corneas. Remarkably, Arpit had just returned home to celebrate Rakshabandhan hours prior to the disaster. Following the collapse, authorities arrested the building owner and initiated a magisterial inquiry, highlighting pressing issues surrounding student accommodation safety in the area.
title: Arpit Jai lost his life in Delhi PG collapse; what his parents did next moved many

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Serena Williams sold her Bel-Air estate for $8.1 million in 2019 after listing it for nearly $12 million in 2017. She had bought the 2.7-acre property for $6.612 million in 2006. The 6,101-square-foot home had six bedrooms, seven bathrooms, a pool, private trails and a full-service hair salon. The final sale still gave Williams a gross profit.
title: Serena Williams’ $8.1m Bel-Air estate: Why did she sell it for less?

description: Pakistan's poor performances have attracted criticism, but the Pakistan Cricket Board's major changes after the second Test have also shocked the cricket world. The PCB sent seven players from the squad back home and sacked head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed and his staff after the second Test. Wasim Akram said he feels for the players, but believes their attitude is also part of the problem.
title: 'I knew we were going to lose 3-0': Wasim Akram's brutal verdict on Pakistan

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Regatta, billed as the world’s longest cruise, has set sail from Rome on a 371-day journey. The ship will visit 220 ports across 62 countries and six continents, offering passengers an extraordinary year-long global adventure. Here’s how much the cruise costs, the destinations on its itinerary and what travelers can expect onboard.
title: World's longest 371-day cruise sets sail from Rome to 62 countries

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Copenhagen’s new £200 million Natural History Museum will open on March 6, 2027, featuring eight immersive underground galleries and a collection of 14 million specimens. Visitors can explore dinosaur skeletons, 3D exhibits and the spectacular Ocean Hall, as the museum combines historic Botanical Garden buildings with striking new underground architecture inspired by nature.
title: Copenhagen's £200m Natural History Museum to open in 2027

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a touching moment, actors Ben and Casey Affleck announced the sad news of their father Timothy Byers Affleck's death this year, following their mother Christopher Anne Affleck's passing in June. Timothy had a diverse career as an actor and playwright, and after conquering alcoholism, he served as a counselor in an alcohol rehabilitation center. The brothers honored their parents by dedicating Casey's film 'Company' at the Venice Film Festival.
title: Ben Affleck and Casey Affleck’s father, Timothy Affleck, passes away

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Iran launched ballistic missiles targeting a United States military base near Al Azraq in Jordan. Jordan's air defenses intercepted most of the missiles, with two falling in unpopulated areas. This attack caused energy markets to react, with Brent crude prices seeing an increase. Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen also launched strikes on Saudi cities. The escalating regional conflict poses risks to military bases and vital energy routes.
title: Watch: Multiple blasts seen over US airbase in Jordan after Iran missile strike

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices climbed towards $100 a barrel on Wednesday, marking the fourth straight session of increases. Renewed hostilities between the United States and Iran have significantly unsettled the crude oil market. Tensions flared as Iran targeted US positions with missiles in response to the destruction of its oil tankers by US forces. This escalating conflict continues to keep oil markets highly volatile.
title: Oil inches closer to $100 per barrel as Iran strikes US targets in Jordan

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: The grief comes at a difficult time for Manu Bhaker, who is already coping with the recent setback involving her coach Jaspal Rana. The shooter was undergoing training in Bhopal as part of her preparations for the Asian Games when she received news of her grandmother's demise. She immediately left for her native village.
title: Manu Bhaker suffers another personal loss; grandmother passes away in Rohtak

author: TNN
description: Delhi Police apprehended the labour contractor supervising the collapsed student hostel.  The building owner allegedly added extra floors, compromising its foundation's stability.  Mahesh Gupta managed the accommodation for his parents, Hariram and Urmila.  The building was leased to PG operator Hostel Daze in August 2025.  Soil samples were collected for forensic examination to determine foundation weakness.
title: Delhi building collapse: Owner knew base was weak, built 4 additional floors, say cops

description: Pakistan captain Babar Azam wants his team to play freely in the final Test.  The Pakistan Cricket Board made significant changes after two heavy defeats. He believes the new players can make an impact in the upcoming match.

description: Nicolas Cage’s $10.5 million Malibu mansion has been hit by a massive sinkhole, with photos showing the driveway collapsing amid suspected coastal erosion. According to KTLA, the crater measures around 30 feet by 30 feet. The 4,000-square-foot beachfront property was purchased by Cage in 2024 and features dramatic ocean views and a rooftop deck.
title: Nicolas Cage's $10.5m Malibu mansion hit by massive 30ft sinkhole

description: A retired assistant commissioner recalled a past security incident involving an army man.  He had allegedly used a tampered NSG identity card and fake pass.  The army man's intention was reportedly to see the Prime Minister as a fan.  A chargesheet was filed, and the trial is still pending.  The army man and his wife later attended another event with a valid pass.
